source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
reference: "Wahini kita baisian tikus baumur 4 bulan nang sudah kada diabetes nang mana asalnya masih diabetes," jar inya.
hypothesis: "Kita kini baisi tikus umur 4 bulan nang kada diabetes nang dahulu diabetes", tambahnya.

source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, paropesor ubat-ubatan di Universitas Dalhousie nang di Halifax, Nova Scotia wan jua kapala bagian klinis wan alamiah dari Parkumpulan Diabetes Urang Kanada mamadahi panalitian ini nih masih pamulaannya haja.
hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, profesor kedokteran di Universitas Dalhousie di Halifax, Nova Scotia wan ketua divisi klinis wan ilmiah dari Asosiasi Diabetes Kanada mamparingati bahwa penelitian masih dalam hari-hari awalnya.

source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
reference: Nangkaya jar babarapa ahli, sidin a’asaan napakah diabetes ini nih kawa ampih, maingat kalo tamuan-tamuan ngini nang kadada bakaitan wan urang-urang nang sudah maharit diabetes janis 1.
hypothesis: Nang kaya ahli lain, inya ragu-ragu apakah diabetes kawa disembuhkan, mancatat bahwa temuan ngini kada relevan lawan urang nang sudah baisi diabetes Tipe 1.

source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
reference: Pas hari Senin, Sara Darius, sekretaris tatap Kumite Panghargaan Literasi di Akademi Swedia, sacara umum mahabarakan liwat acara radiunya Radiu Sveriges di Swedia, bubuhan angguta kumite kadada nang kawa mahubungi Bob Dylan langsung gasan mamadahi bahuwa inya mamanangakan Hadiah Panghargaan Literasi Tahun 2016, jadi sia-sia haja.
hypothesis: Pagi ini, Sara Danius, sekretaris tetap Komite Nobel gasan Sastra di Swedish Academy, mengumumkan secara terbuka selama program radio di Sveriges Radio di Swedia bahwa komite, kada kawa mancapai Bob Dylan langsung tentang memenangkan Hadiah Nobel dalam Sastra 2016, telah meninggalkan usahanya gasan mancapai sidin.

source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
reference: Jar Danius, "Wahini, kami lagi kadada beapa-apa. Aku sudah mahubungi wan mangirimi surat elektrunik ka kulaburator nang parak wan inya imbah tu kami manarima balasannya nang ramah bangat. Jadi, gasan wahini cukup haja dulu."
hypothesis: Danius ujar, "Kini kami kada bagawi apa-apa. Aku sudah manunggal wan manuruih email ka kolaburannya nang paling parak wan manarima jawaban nang ramah banar.

source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
reference: Sabalumnya, CEO-nya Ring, Jamie Siminoff, mamadahi parusahaan sudah mulai jalan pas bel rumah inya kada babunyi matan toko inya nang baandak di garasi inya.
hypothesis: Sebelumnya, CEO Ring, Jamie Siminoff, mancatat parusahaan dimulai pas bel pintu sidin kada kawa didangar dari warungnya di garasi sidin.

source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
reference: Inya baulah bel WiFi, jarnya.
hypothesis: inya maulah bell pintu wifi, katanya.

source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
reference: Jar Siminoff panjualan batambah imbah panampilannya di Shark Tank tahun 2013, nang mana inpestor manulak pandanaan bisnis hanyarnya.
hypothesis: Siminoff ujar penjualan meningkat imbah penampilan sidin tahun 2013 di episode Shark Tank di mana panel acara tulak membari dana startup.

source: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
reference: Pas akhir tahun 2017, Siminoff batampil di saluran tipi balanja, QVC.
hypothesis: Di akhir 2017, Siminoff muncul di saluran televisi belanja QVC.

source: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
reference: Ring jua manuntungakan urusan hukum wan parusahaan kaamanan saingan, ADT Corporation.
hypothesis: Ring jua manuntungakan tuntutan hukum lawan parusahaan keamanan saingannya, ADT Corporation.

source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
reference: Pas kamunculan sabuting paksin parcubaan kawa mangurangi angka kamatian Ebola, sampai wahini, kadada lalu ubat nang sudah ditunjukakan sasuai gasan pananganan inpeksi nang ada.
hypothesis: Walaupun sabuting vaksin eksperimen nampaknya kawa mengurangi kematian Ebola, sampai wayah ini, kada ada obat nang sudah jelas ditamui nang cocok gasan mengobati infeksi nang ada.

source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
reference: Sabuting antibodi koktail, ZMapp, pas pamulaan kalihatan manjanjiakan pas dicuba, tapi panalitian-panalitian rasmi manunjukakan ini nih kurang masih manapaatnya gasan mancagah kamatian.
hypothesis: Sabuting koktail antibodi, ZMapp, awalnya manunjukakan janji di lapangan, tagal studi formal manunjukakan inya baisi manfaat kurang daripada nang dihandaki dalam mamadahi kamatian.

source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
reference: Di parcubaan PALM, ZMapp dipakai gasan pangandali, nang ba’arti buhan panaliti mamakainya gasan dasar wan mambandingakan tiga parawatan lainnya lawan ngitu.
hypothesis: Dalam uji PALM, ZMapp manjabat sabagai kontrol, artinya para ilmuwan manggunaakannya sabagai garis dasar wan mambandingakan talu pangobatan lainnya lawan itu.

source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
reference: Pasenaman Amerika Serikat mandukung isi Komite Ulimpiade Amerika Serikat wan manarima kabutuhan mutlak kaluarga Ulimpiade gasan ma’adaakan sabuah lingkungan nang aman hagan atlit kita barataan.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics mendukung surat Komite Olimpiade Amerika Serikat wan manarima parluan mutlak keluarga Olimpiade gasan mapromosi lingkungan nang aman gasan sabarataan atlit kita.

source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
reference: Kami satuju wan parnyataan USOC bahuwa kapantingan klub wan atlit kita, wan cabang ulahraga buhannya, mungkin dilayani labih baik lagi kaya malangkah maju wan parubahan nang ba’arti dalam kapangurusan kita daripada mandesertifikasiakan.
hypothesis: Kami setuju lawan pernyataan USOC bahwa kepentingan atlit wan klub kami, wan olahraga mereka, kawa labih baik dilayanan lawan maju lawan parubahan nang berarti dalam organisasi kami, daripada decertification.

source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
reference: Pasenaman Amerika Serikat mandukung pamariksaan mandiri nang bisa mahawasi panyalahgunaan parbandingan nang liwar jalas ditampaiakan ulih bubuhan panyintas Larry Nassar kawa kada katahuan batahunan wan tarmasuk parubahan nang sasuai wan pas.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics mendukung penyelidikan independen nang mungkin menyinari bagaimana penyalahgunaan proporsi nang dijelasakan dengan berani oleh urang-urang nang selamat dari Larry Nassar bisa kada terdeteksi selama ini dan mencakup perubahan nang diperlukan dan pas.

source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
reference: Pasenaman Amerika Serikat wan USOC baisi tujuan nang sama — maulah cabang ulahraga, wan cabang ulahraga lainya jua, sa’aman mungkin hagan buhan atlit dalam manyasah mimpinya di lingkungan nang aman, pusitip, wan mandukung.
hypothesis: USA Gymnastics wan USOC baisi tujuan nang sama  gasan maulah ulah raga gimnastik, wan nang lain, aman mungkin gasan atlit gasan maumpati impian buhannya di lingkungan nang aman, positif wan mampangkin.

source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
reference: Salawas tahun 1960-an, Brzekzinski bagawi gasan John F. Kennedy sabagai panasihatnya imbah tu administrasi Lyndon B. Johnson.
hypothesis: Salawas 1960-an, Brzezinski bagawi gasan John F. Kennedy sabagai penasihat wan imbah itu administrasi Lyndon B. Johnson.

source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
reference: Salawas pamilihan tahun 1976 inya manyaranakan Carter di kabijakan asing, imbah tu mangabdi sabagai Panasihat Kaamanan Nasional (NSA) matan tahun 1977 sampai 1981, manggantiakan Henry Kissinger.
hypothesis: Salawas pamilihan tahun 1976 sidin manasihat Carter tentang kabijakan luar negeri, lalu manjabat sabagai Penasihat Keamanan Nasional (NSA) matan 1977 sampai 1981, manunggu Henry Kissinger.

source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
reference: Pas di NSA, inya mangganii Carter maurusi urusan dunia sacara diplumatis, nangkaya Camp David Accords, 1978; mambaikakan hubungan Cina–Amerika Serikat di akhir 1970—an; Ripolusi Iran, nang mangarah ka krisis tawanan Iran, 1979; wan panjajahan Soviet di Afganistan, 1979.
hypothesis: Sebagai NSA, sidin manbantu Carter dalam manangani urusan dunia sacara diplomatik, kaya Perjanjian Camp David, 1978; normalisasi hubungan ASChina dipikirakan akhir 1970-an; Revolusi Iran, nang manyabapakan krisis sandera Iran, 1979; wan invasi Soviet di Afghanistan, 1979.

source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
reference: Pelem nang dibintangi Ryan Gosling wan Emma Stone, manarima pancalunan di sabarataan kalumpuk utama.
hypothesis: Film nang ba'isi Ryan Gosling wan Emma Stone, manarima nominasi di sabarataan kategori utama.

source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
reference: Gosling wan Stone manarima pancalunan gasan Aktur wan Aktris Pambaiknya.
hypothesis: Gosling wan Stone mandapatakan nominasi gasan Aktor Terbaik wan Aktris.

source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
reference: Pancalunan nang lainnya maliputi Gambar Pambaiknya, Direktor, Sinematograpi, Disain Kostum, Panyuntingan Pelem, Skor Original, Disain Produksi, Panyuntingan Suara, Maulah Suara, wan Sakenario Asli.
hypothesis: Nominasi nang lain tamasuk pilem paling baik, sutradara, sinematografi, desain kostum, pengeditan pilem, skor asli, desain produksi, pengeditan suara, pencampuran suara wan skenario asli.

source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
reference: Dua lagu matan pelem, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) wan City of Stars, dapat panacalunan gasan lagu asli pambaiknya. Studio Lionsgate dapat 26 pancalunan — tabanyak matam studio nang lain.
hypothesis: Dua lagu dari pilem, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) wan City of Stars, mandapat nominasi gasan lagu asli nang paling baik. Lionsgate studio mandapatakan 26 nominasi  labih banyak daripada studio lain.

source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
reference: Pada hari Ahad, Presiden Amerika Serikat Donald Trump, dalam habarnya nang dihabarakan liwat pers sekretaris, mahabarakan tantara Amerika Serikat handak maninggalakan Syria.
hypothesis: Malam hari Minggu, Presiden Amerika Serikat Donald Trump, dalam pernyataan nang disampaikan melalui sekretaris pers, manumumkan pasukan AS akan meninggalkan Suriah.

source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
reference: Habarnya diulah pas Donald Trump imbah bateleponan wan Presiden Turki Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
hypothesis: Pengumuman ngini diulah imbah Trump baisi parbicaraan telepon lawan Presiden Turki Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
reference: Turki kena jua maambil alih panjagaan bubuhan pajuang ISIS nang tatangkap nang mana jar habarnya, nagara-nagara Eropa sudah manulak gasan mambulikakan.
hypothesis: Turki jua akan mengambil alih penjaga pejuang ISIS nang ditangkap nang, ujar pernyataan itu, negara-negara Eropa telah menolak untuk mengembalikan.

source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
reference: Ini nih kada hanya gasan mamastiakan bahuwa paling kada babarapa dinosaurus bisi bulu, teorinya sudah manyabar luas, tapi rincian fusil mamadahakan kada, nangkaya warna wan susunan tiga dimensinya.
hypothesis: Hal ini kada hanya manakuakan bahwa paling kada babarapa dinosaurus baisi bulu, sabuah teori nang sudah luas, tapi mandapatakan rincian nang umumnya kada kawa dihandaki fosil, kaya warna wan tata tata tata nang tiga dimensi.

source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
reference: Jar bubuhan panaliti bulu binatang ini nih bawarna cuklat kastanye pucat di atas atawa karotenoid di bagian bawah.
hypothesis: Para ilmuwan bilang buluan binatang ini tuh coklat kaya chestnut di atas dengan bagian bawahnya warnanya pucat atau karotenoid.

source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
reference: Panamuannya jua mananggung wawasan tantang epolusi bulu di burung.
hypothesis: Panamuan ngini jua mambari pangatahuan tentang evolusi bulu di burung.

source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
reference: Sabab bulu dinosaurus kada bisi purus pusat nang marangkat sampurna, nang ngarannya rachis, tapi baciri bulu lain — duri wan barbule — bubuhan panaliti manyimpulakan rachis itu nangkaya rangkatan epolusi lanjutan matan ciri-ciri lain ngini.
hypothesis: Karana bulu dinosaurus kada baisi sumbu nang baik diulah, disambat rachis, tagal baisi ciri lain dari bulu  barbs wan barbules  para peneliti manyimpulakan rachis mungkin merupakan perkembangan evolusioner nang labih tarakhir daripada ciri-ciri lain ini.

source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
reference: Susunan bulu-bulu ngini mamadahiakan kalu ngini kada gasan tarabang tapi gasan ma’atur suhu atawa panampilan. Bubuhan panaliti bapikiran bahuwa biar ngini nih buntut dinosaurus anum, sampelnya manampaiakan bulu dewasa wan lainan bulu bawah.
hypothesis: Struktur bulu ngini manunjukakan bahwa buhannya kada dipakai gasan manunggang tapi gasan manatur suhu atawa manunjukakan.
